ghosts_rejected.claim: tests/test_animation_volume.py has an xfail / finalizer teardown bug
ghosts_rejected.evidence: zero occurrences of xfail and zero of finalizer in the file; the only 'skip' hits are three module-level pytest.importorskip guards at :50, :51, :52-54; and no skip or xfail masks a teardown failure either
ghosts_rejected.note: A real teardown bug did live in this same file, and it is a different one: _boot installed the start double on the class first, so MonkeyPatch.setattr recorded the instance value through the MRO as that class double, and the undo then wrote the double onto the instance, where it permanently shadowed the restored Server.start. Repaired in commit a588603 at tests/test_animation_volume.py:264-273 (vars(srv).pop("start", None) / srv.start = shadow). a588603 touches no file other than that test file.
